approval: Root approved explicit trusted Python rule metadata, optional native keyword and source-preserving validator_value. Root requested subject-origin preservation after display-path ambiguity was independently confirmed.
scope: Already exposed compiled Python consumer error fields: validator, validator_value, instance, instance path and schema path. Strict core fallback remains a separately qualified profile.
requiredSemantics: Preserve native display paths even when they do not locate the original root schema rule or actual subject.
A referenced type error can have schemaPath [type] and validator_value number even when the original root contains only a reference. Carry the actual keyword rule from trusted Rust construction.
Boolean false-schema errors have native validator None and validator_value None. Other false aggregate keyword errors, such as Draft2020 items:false, retain their own keyword/value/subject.

A propertyNames error has the actual property name as error.instance despite empty display instancePath. A direct nested false-schema error can similarly have child instance9 despite empty display path. Carry physical subject origin independently.
Preserve Python integer versus float numeric kind and exact source code points in rule values and evaluated subjects.

internalApi.pythonKeyword: Option<PyText>; None for genuine native boolean-schema errors. Keep the ordinary ECMA StructuralError keyword representation unchanged.
internalApi.validatorValue: Source-preserving PythonConsumerValue from the actual keyword rule, with explicit bound override for min/maxContains and child required:true in Draft3. Native None is represented as Python Null.
internalApi.subjectOrigin: Trusted physicalInstancePath plus optional instanceOverride for ephemeral subjects, or an equivalent shared immutable source-view locator. Keep native display instancePath separate. Field presence distinguishes an override whose value is None from no override.
internalApi.binding: Typed PyO3 result carries explicit rule/subject metadata. Compiled consumer facade consumes it; no heuristic re-traversal from display schemaPath or instancePath. Public Diagnostic, Value and closed generic wire remain unchanged.
internalApi.ownership: Prefer shared owned source snapshots, borrowed views or small overrides. Do not deep-copy the complete root instance per error or the complete schema per node solely to preserve metadata.

resourceRequirements: Use caller Context before rule/subject/path/message/keyword projection, metadata buffers, annotation key materialization and dynamic-scope copies.
Use existing source-origin maps to reconstruct source rules without losing explicit surrogate-pair versus astral identity or numeric kind.
No 4M private-copy cap and no ordinary structural re-admission of internal wrappers. Operational errors propagate; they are never reclassified as validation errors or deferred arithmetic failures.
qualification: Only the exposed fields listed here are qualified. Exact native exception class/message identity and the entire jsonschema exception API are not claimed. Existing normalized Rust validation envelope is retained.
verificationStatus: All frozen native metadata and subject records independently match CPython3.11.17/3.12.15/3.13.16 with jsonschema4.26.0. Production implementation and coherent native/installed verification pending.
